items.html:
Originally from Pakistan, this right-handed middle-order  batsman
is one of the best bats in the side.  Some of his notable perfor-
mances helped win the ICC tournament for the UAE.  His 72 not out
in  the  semi-finals versus Holland rescued his side from a shaky
start and his explosive match-winning 51 off 36 balls in the  fi-
nals against hosts Kenya, garnered him the Man of the Match award
from Sir Clyde Walcott.
